github.name: GitHub
github.prompt: Enter your existing GitHub username, or create a personal account using the signup link. Never enter a password, API token, recovery code or cookie. Reuse your existing account.

link_verification.notes: Official signup form inspected; official profile instructions used because settings require authentication.

overleaf.name: Overleaf
overleaf.prompt: Enter an email address confirmed on your existing Overleaf account for project invitations, or create an account using the signup link. Never enter a password, API token, recovery code or cookie. Reuse your existing account.

link_verification.notes: Signup inspected; settings redirects to sign-in, and the settings URL is documented officially.

orcid.name: ORCID
orcid.prompt: Enter your existing ORCID iD (0000-0000-0000-0000) or full https://orcid.org/ URL. Search for your existing record before registering another one. Never enter a password, API token, recovery code or cookie. Reuse your existing account.

link_verification.notes: Official application routes respond with JavaScript shell; identifier structure and checksum documented by ORCID.

zotero.name: Zotero
zotero.prompt: Enter your existing Zotero username, or register using the signup link. Group membership will be checked separately. Never enter a password, API token, recovery code or cookie. Reuse your existing account.

link_verification.notes: Registration page inspected; profile settings redirects to official sign-in.

zenodo.name: Zenodo
zenodo.prompt: Enter the username shown in your existing Zenodo profile, or register using the signup link. This does not choose a publisher or authorize publication. Never enter a password, API token, recovery code or cookie. Reuse your existing account.

link_verification.notes: Signup form and official profile navigation inspected. Use documented Profile menu; do not guess an account settings route.
